name: Relevance
description: Measures how closely the response relates to the context and previous messages in the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates how engaging and interesting the response is, encouraging further conversation.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and clarity of the response within the context of the conversation.

name: Creativity
description: Rates the originality and inventiveness of the response, particularly in adding new information or perspectives.

name: Emotion
description: Measures the emotional tone of the response, considering whether it adds warmth, humor, or empathy to the conversation.
